entries.610723395ed024ba: A transaction in which a leasing company lends machinery or equipment to a company for a fixed period and receives lease payments. Leases are divided into "finance leases," which cannot be canceled midway and in which the lease payments cover almost the entire cost the leasing company incurred for the equipment, and "operating leases," which are all others.
